upgrades.what: Consensus replacement (Votor + Rotor) targeting ~150ms finality, retiring the current TowerBFT vote-by-transaction design.
Referenced in the brief as an upcoming change; tracked live from the solana-improvement-documents repository feed.
Independent validator client from Jump; matters for client diversity and therefore for liveness risk.
